Position Summary 
As a Test Technician, you bring Velo3D’s metal additive manufacturing printers to life. Working from written, step-by-step procedures, you take newly assembled printers through three stages of test: 
Subsystem bring-up (Level 600) — power up and verify each subsystem in turn: electrical and safety interlocks, gas and compressed air, cooling, motion, powder handling, laser optics, controls and software. 
System validation (Level 700) — confirm the subsystems work together and the printer meets its acceptance criteria. 
Final qualification (Level 800) — support the last qualification checks and sign-off before a printer is released. 
Once trained, you run these steps on your own and know when to stop and ask for help. Full training is provided — you don’t need to know our procedures coming in. Success looks like procedures followed exactly, problems flagged early with clear detail, and test records complete enough to reconstruct any build months later. 


Essential Functions
• Pre-power checks — Before anything is switched on, check wiring continuity, insulation, polarity and grounding, and confirm the printer is built to the correct configuration. 

• Bring-up (Level 600) — Power up and verify each subsystem in sequence; perform pressure and leak checks on the gas, vacuum and coolant lines. 

• Calibration and software — Calibrate sensors, gauges, temperature controls and motion systems; load firmware and software and apply the settings for each printer. 

• Validation (Level 700) — Run the full system test sequence to confirm the printer meets its acceptance criteria. 

• Final qualification (Level 800) — Support Test Engineering during final qualification and hand off each printer with all open items clearly documented. 

• Troubleshooting — Diagnose
